evidence_expectations: exact base, current state, changed files, and patch digest
each proof obligation bound only to registered command Evidence
unsatisfied or unknown proof prevents READY
failure_shape: not-ready: a proof obligation remains unknown or incomplete
blocked: bound repository state changed or authority was denied

parameter_influence.rationale: repositoryRoot materializes filesystem_state; the parameter directly influences the snapshot the runtime reads. customDigest (declared material for the G5-B positive exercise fixture) is an ordinarily-named, non-optional parameter; if the diff adds it without binding it in the function body, parameter_usage_finder deterministically refutes it and adjudication routes to NOT_READY. Any parameter not in this list has no authoritative input-influence claim under this capability.
